title: Memberships
subtitle: Which circle each contestant belongs to — the full history, not just the present
enrol_title: Enrol a contestant in a circle
joined_at_hint: Leave empty for today. It cannot be in the future.
one_open_membership_hint: A contestant may belong to only one circle at a time. If they already belong somewhere, use Transfer rather than Enrol.
circles_truncated: Showing the first 100 circles only. If the one you need is missing, use the Circles screen.
end_explanation: The contestant's membership of “{{circle}}” will end. Nothing is deleted: the record keeps both dates so anyone reviewing later can read it.
left_at_hint: Leave empty for today. It cannot be in the future.
transfer_explanation: The contestant will move from “{{circle}}” to another circle. The current membership closes and the new one opens in a single operation, so they are never left in neither circle — or in both.
transfer_at_hint: Leave empty for today. It cannot be in the future.
error_reason_long: The reason is too long (500 characters maximum).
error_date_future: The date cannot be in the future.
